product_overview: DecibelCity is an educational sound-mapping and citizen noise reporting prototype for Huancayo, Junín. It lets visitors explore an OpenStreetMap-based map, inspect illustrative noise hotspots, measure relative microphone amplitude locally, and prepare or submit verified noise reports after signing in.
core_goals: Let visitors explore the map and hotspot information without creating an account.
Allow users to prepare a noise report as a draft before authentication.
Require a verified server session only when submitting a report.
Support voluntary citizen registration with Junín territorial selection.
Enable secure login and logout using an HttpOnly session cookie.
Provide legal and privacy information about data use, microphone access, and report scope.

features.name: Exploration of the map and critical noise points
features.description: Users can browse the interactive map, inspect illustrative noise hotspots, and view hotspot details from either the map or the hotspot list.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Browse the interactive map -> Select a hotspot marker -> View the hotspot popup with decibel level and illustrative description
Navigate to /puntos-criticos -> Review the hotspot list and map -> Select a hotspot entry -> See the associated hotspot details and reference information

features.name: Preparation and draft preservation of a noise report
features.description: Users can search for a place in Huancayo, choose a noise source, write observations, optionally include microphone level information, and keep the report draft when authentication is required.
user_flows: Navigate to /reportar -> Search for a place or address in Huancayo -> Select a suggested place -> Choose a noise source -> Write a description of the noise -> Enable or measure the relative microphone level -> Submit the report and continue to authentication while preserving the draft

Navigate to /reportar -> Search for a place or address in Huancayo -> Select a suggested place -> Choose a noise source -> Write a description of the noise -> Submit the report without an active session -> See redirection to /login with the draft preserved

features.name: Volunteer citizen registration
features.description: Users can create a citizen account by completing the registration form and selecting department, province, and district within Junín.
user_flows: Navigate to /registro -> Enter names and surnames -> Enter phone number and address -> Select the Junín department -> Select a province -> Select a district within the chosen province -> Enter a username and password -> Complete registration -> See successful authentication and return to the previous destination
Navigate to /registro -> Enter registration details -> Choose mismatched territorial selections -> Attempt to complete registration -> See validation feedback and remain on the form

features.name: Login and logout with HttpOnly session cookies
features.description: Registered users can sign in with username and password, see their authenticated profile state, and log out to revoke the session.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Enter username -> Enter password -> Submit the login form -> See the user profile in the navigation bar
Navigate to /login -> Enter username -> Enter password -> Submit the login form -> See successful authentication and return to the previous destination
Use the authenticated session -> Open the profile area -> Sign out -> See the session end and return to the logged-out state

features.name: Privacy and terms review
features.description: Users can read the service privacy policy and usage conditions from the legal routes.
user_flows: Navigate to /privacidad -> Read how report data, account data, microphone access, and OpenStreetMap usage are handled
Navigate to /condiciones -> Read the service terms and usage conditions
